exposure: age less than 16 years at first pregnancy
travel time more than 60 minutes to reach final place of care
cohort: Women seeking obstetric care at six public hospitals in Tigray Region, Northern Ethiopia
finding: Women with no formal education, less than 16 years of age at first pregnancy, induced labor, history of cesarean section or chronic medical disorder, and who traveled more than 60 minutes to reach their final place of care had higher odds of experiencing a maternal near miss.
